author: lastasylum
text:
In <Last Asylum: Survival>, there are a variety of buildings, each with unique features.
Almost all buildings can be upgraded to a higher level by clicking the green arrow.Upgrading buildings boosts your strength and unlocks additional bonuses.
The level of each building is always capped at the current level of the Sanctuary. Building upgrades require strategic planning around the Sanctuary level. Prioritize upgrading the Sanctuary, use Builder's Hut to reduce construction time, and gradually enhance Research, Barracks, Training Grounds, and Infirmary based on your needs. This balanced approach ensures might and resource growth, preventing issues like restricted troop training or stagnant progress.Below is a breakdown of the core functions of key buildings.

**Sanctuary**
The Sanctuary is the most vital building, as it dictates the max level of all other structures.
After upgrading the Sanctuary, the following stats will increase:
•Might
•Hero Level Cap
•Hero HP
•Hero ATK
•Hero DEF
•Building Level Cap
Additionally, upgrading the Sanctuary will also:
•Grant EXP rewards (EXP gain shown in upgrade image);
•Unlock new buildings.

author: lastasylum
text:
Builder's Hut

In the early game, when your base is below Lv.15, the Builder's Hut will be your most valuable asset.
This building grants you free construction speedups.By keeping the Builder's Hut at the same level as the Sanctuary, you can rapidly upgrade numerous other structures.
Here, you can see which survivors are working in this building.You can also replace existing Survivors with others who offer higher bonus effects.

author: lastasylum
text:
Infirmary

When you suffer a defeat in battle, some of your soldiers won't be killed outright; instead, they'll be critically injured and sent to the Infirmary.This is the Infirmary's core function: healing wounded troops.
How it works:
Troops injured in battle are sent to the Infirmary.
You need to consume certain resources (such as Gold, Medicine, or time) to heal these troops.
Once healing is complete, troops will recover to full health and rejoin your army for future battles.

Many more buildings await your exploration in the game. Master the rhythm of building upgrades and lay a solid foundation for your base. This way, you'll be able to face challenges in the post-apocalyptic world of Last Asylum: Survival with greater confidence and continuously grow your power!

Antitoxin is a crucial resource for character progression and overall might growth. It can be primarily obtained through three methods: daily gameplay, event rewards, and pack purchases.

**I. Daily Gameplay**
1. Antitoxin Workshop & Stable Production
•Antitoxin Workshop produces antitoxins at regular intervals.
•The higher the level of the Antitoxin Workshop, the more antitoxins you'll get per unit time.
•Antitoxins can be collected via the Stable, making it one of the stable sources of antitoxins.

thread: Hero Upgrade: How To Get Antitoxin
author: lastasylum
text:
** 4. Covert Ops Force & Caravan Trade**
•Both completing Covert Ops Force Quests and Caravan Trade will earn you Antitoxins.
•You can get antitoxins whether you complete your own quests or plunder others'.

•Each player can plunder others' Covert Operation up to 5 times per day.
•The amount of Antitoxins obtained from Covert Operation varies by color, with Golden Covert Operations offering the highest rewards.

•Spend 10 Stamina to hunt Blight.

text:
**Same-Unit Type Lineup Bonuses**

Using heroes of the same unit type in your team triggers additional attribute boosts (HP, ATK, DEF). The more same-type heroes you have, the higher the bonus:
•3 same-type heroes: 5% attribute increase
•4 same-type heroes: 15% attribute increase
•5 same-type heroes: 20% attribute increase
This makes building a same-unit type lineup an excellent choice for your main team, as it delivers substantial overall benefits.

R5 → Where is the line, and are we willing to cross it?

author: vordac
text:
Nice guide! Can probably fill out the info for the other lineups. 

3 melee and melee back/ranged front are fundementally similar except the latter is objectively worse. Back-line melee  in general follow the same target priority for ranged in position 3, 4 and 5. But by having ranged in position 1 and 2 to my testing it allowed the opposition to freely target the weakest unit in those positions. The only advantage was if you manage to clear the opposition tanks their range will prioritise your melee over ranged, with their positions 3, 4 and 5 having an individual tank.

author: vordac
text: 4 ranged has a more pronounced effect on target priority. If you have a ranged unit in position 2 facing a melee unit in 2-2, your positions 3, 4 and 5 will prioritise clearing melee units in 2-2 (both melee units if the opponent fields a melee at 2-5) before defaulting to the tipping phase you've outlined. Fundamentally this is the most accessible way to break priority order outside of natural dynamic targetters like Jester.

text:
From what a few people have told me, it really depends on the type of player you are. Are you free-to-play, willing to spend a little, or planning to spend heavily? Either way, I think it’s important to eventually decide on a main faction/team as you progress.

text:
Rangers counter warriors… which is why many players start rangers early (and do well mid game)

Warlocks counter rangers… and yes take the longest to upgrade (research tree).  But as many people start working on rangers (to counter warriors) some will work on warlocks to counter those who are making ranger teams!

author: novelcroshoes
text:
It’s a trade off

If you want rangers to be your “forever squad” (you need one squad you actively and aggressively upgrade forever, the other squads upgrade more passively unless you are an uber whale)… the sooner you start on rangers the better.

The down side to this is your actual BEST squad NOW (warrior) gets stuck in limbo next 2-6 weeks… and slowly over that time underperforms.

Some people would push all the warrior UR to at least 8 star then move over, others all way to 10 star, I moved faction when I had warriors 10/8/10/10/8.

There is no real right or wrong, but if you want to be rangers long term, the earlier you make the transition the better, and I don’t know anyone that went ranger early regret it mid game.

**LES HÉROS ET LES COMPOS**

⸻

🧠 **GUIDE RAPIDE – COMPOSITION & STRATÉGIE**

⚔️ **Rôles des héros**

* 🛡️ Tank (guerriers) → devant → encaissent les dégâts
* ⚔️ DPS (rôdeurs / démonistes) → derrière → infligent les dégâts

👉 Une bonne équipe = tanks + DPS

⸻

🔺 **Système de counter**

* 🛡️ Tanks → forts vs démonistes
* 🏹 Rôdeurs → forts vs tanks
* 🔮 Démonistes → forts vs rôdeurs

👉 C’est un système pierre / feuille / ciseaux

⸻

💀 **Hard counter**

* Quand une faction bat très facilement une autre
* Exemple : rôdeurs vs tanks

👉 À éviter absolument sinon tu perds même avec plus de puissance

⸻

🧬 **Bonus de faction**

* 3 mêmes héros → +5%
* 3 + 2 → +10% ✅ (meilleur choix)
* 4 mêmes → +15%
* 5 mêmes → +20% ❌ (trop risqué)

👉 Recommandé : 3 + 2

⸻

🛡️ **Formation idéale**

* Avant (2 places) → tanks obligatoires
* Arrière (3 places) → DPS

⸻

🏆 **Meilleure composition (safe)**

👉 2 tanks devant + 3 DPS derrière
👉 Avec 3 héros d’une faction + 2 d’une autre

✔ Bon bonus
✔ Bonne survie
✔ Peu sensible aux counters

⸻

🔥 **META & ANTI-META**

* META → ce que tout le monde joue (les meilleures compos du moment)
* ANTI-META → ce qui bat la méta

👉 Exemple :

* Beaucoup de tanks = méta
* Tu joues rôdeurs = anti-méta

⸻

⚠️ **Erreurs à éviter**

* ❌ Pas de tanks devant
* ❌ Full une seule faction (facile à counter)
* ❌ Ignorer le counter ennemi
* ❌ Compo sans équilibre

⸻

🎯 **Règle d’or**

👉 Toujours adapter ta compo à l’adversaire

⸻

🧩 **Résumé ultra court**

* Tanks devant, DPS derrière
* Système triangle = tout
* 3 + 2 factions = optimal
* Évite les hard counters
* Adapte-toi à la méta

# ☣️ UNDEAD SIEGE – GUIDE D'ALLIANCE

## 🎯 Objectif

Défendez votre alliance contre **20 vagues d'Undead** et survivez le plus longtemps possible.

🏆 Plus vous résistez, plus les récompenses individuelles et d'alliance seront importantes.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

## 📅 Avant l'événement

🔎 Les membres de l'alliance doivent accomplir les **Falcon Quests** afin de récupérer des indices.

👑 Les R4/R5 utilisent ces indices pour :
• Localiser la **Death Prison**.
• Choisir le niveau de difficulté adapté à l'alliance.
• Planifier l'heure de lancement.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

## 🛡️ Préparation

✅ Activez la défense sur votre mur.
✅ Rappelez toutes vos marches.
✅ Préparez votre meilleure formation défensive.
❌ N'activez **pas** de bouclier (ils sont inefficaces contre les Undead).
👥 Seuls les joueurs connectés participent aux renforts.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

## 🤝 Pendant l'événement

📤 Envoyez toutes vos marches disponibles en renfort chez les membres connectés.

📥 Recevez également des renforts afin de renforcer votre propre défense.

🎯 Répartissez intelligemment les renforts afin qu'aucun membre ne soit éliminé prématurément.

💬 Suivez les consignes des R4/R5.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

## 🌊 Les vagues

🟢 **Vagues 1 à 10**
• Mise en place.
• Difficulté faible.

🟡 **Vagues 11 à 15**
• Les attaques deviennent plus intenses.
• Les renforts deviennent indispensables.

🔴 **Vagues 16 à 20**
• Difficulté très élevée.
• La coordination de l'alliance est essentielle.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

## ❌ À ne pas faire

🚫 Ne soignez **pas** vos troupes pendant l'événement.
🚫 N'activez **pas** de bouclier.
🚫 N'envoyez **pas** de renforts aux joueurs hors ligne.
🚫 Ne laissez **aucune** marche inactive si elle peut renforcer un allié.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

## 🏆 Récompenses

🎁 **Récompenses individuelles**
Selon le nombre de vagues auxquelles vous survivez.

🎁 **Récompenses d'alliance**
Selon le nombre total de vagues défendues par l'alliance.

💡 Chaque vague supplémentaire augmente les récompenses de toute l'alliance.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🔥 **La puissance est un atout, mais la coordination fait la victoire !**

author: 5sunburn
text:
----------

**UNDERSTAND HOW HEROES COMPO WORKS**

⸻

🧠 **QUICK GUIDE – TEAM COMPOSITION & STRATEGY**

⚔️ **Hero Roles**

* 🛡️ Tanks (Warriors) → front → absorb damage
* ⚔️ DPS (Rangers / Warlocks) → back → deal damage

👉 A good team = tanks + DPS

⸻

🔺 **Counter System**

* 🛡️ Tanks → strong vs. Warlocks
* 🏹 Rangers → strong against tanks
* 🔮 Warlocks → strong vs. Rangers

👉 It's a rock/paper/scissors system

⸻

💀 **Hard Counter**

* When a faction very easily defeats a Other
*Example: Rangers vs. Tanks

👉 Absolutely avoid this, otherwise you'll lose even with more power

⸻

🧬 **Faction Bonus**

* 3 of the same heroes → +5%
* 3 + 2 → +10% ✅ (best choice)
* 4 of the same → +15%
* 5 of the same → +20% ❌ (too risky)

👉 Recommended: 3 + 2

⸻

🛡️ **Ideal Formation**

* Front (2 slots) → Tanks required
* Rear (3 slots) → DPS

⸻

🏆 **Best (Safest) Composition**

👉 2 tanks in front + 3 DPS in the rear
👉 With 3 heroes from one faction + 2 from another Other

✔ Good bonus
✔ Good survivability
✔ Counters with low sensitivity

⸻

🔥 **META & ANTI-META**

* META → what everyone is playing (the best compositions at the moment)
* ANTI-META → what beats the meta

👉Example:

* Lots of tanks = meta
* You're playing rangers = anti-meta

⸻

⚠️ **Mistakes to avoid**

* ❌No tanks in front
* ❌Fully one faction (easy to counter)
* ❌Ignoring the enemy counter
* ❌Unbalanced composition

⸻

🎯 **Golden rule**

👉 Always adapt your composition to the opponent

⸻

🧩 **Ultra short summary**

* Tanks in front, DPS behind
* Triangle system = everything
* 3 + 2 factions = optimal
* Avoid hard counters
* Adapt to the meta

- rare item;

- progress through the season;
- obtain additional bonuses.

- Monsters.
- Elite Blight.
- Events.
- Seasonal buildings.

⚠️ Participating in another player's rally does NOT count as your first personal kill.

➡️ Each player must achieve their own First Kill.

text:
The Case for an 8-Star Red Lady (The Strategic Argument)
The "One-Trick Pony" Weakness: If you put everything into 10-star Marlena and she gets stunned by an enemy Red Lady (that 35% chance we talked about), you have 0% damage on the board for 5 seconds. You will lose to players with much lower Might because you have no "Plan B."

The Stun Race: As we saw in your screenshots, Red Lady’s 13.6s cooldown and 5s stun are meta-defining. An 8-star Red Lady provides Utility that a 10-star Marlena cannot: she shuts down the enemy so Marlena can work safely.

Tenacity Sharing: Having two 8-star heroes means you have two heroes with the +20% HP/DEF/ATK "Tenacity" buffs. It makes your whole squad harder to wipe out with one lucky hit.

text:
Since it's been asked a few times...

You can only send one march. You cannot speed said march up.

I'd recommend to rally but the initial march might be a race - Better to get others out via a large hit.

If you are not worried about city attacks port to the mud (of course no shield allowed).

The turrets do NOT activate - Those are for KVK only

Four hours to take - If an alliance gets over a % of occupation then it goes faster. Longer obviously if its a struggle.

Keep an eye on your troops reinforcing they will be chipped down unless you're a whale/have high level. - Remove and reinforce again as you need.

Make reinforce is 30 people.  Keep your members sending troops.

Points are gained IF another alliance attacks and you defends OR if you attack.

Only those with a level 6 can take the castle.  the rest - I'd recommend going to resource tiles and hitting for points.  We do this anyway in S2 since we "cycle" out the castle to avoid casualties before Raid day.

Don't forget to hand the chests out (Royal commendation - R5 only - Click the castle afterwards).

Enjoy the chaos of the 1st time.

thread: Как не тратить лишние ускорители: Гид по «Помощи Альянса»
author: ikona_in
text:
Привет! Если ты только начинаешь свой путь и вошёл в альянс, то наверняка заметил иконку с рукопожатием. Это не просто знак вежливости, а реальный способ сэкономить дни стройки. Разбираемся, как это работает.

📊 Математика проста:
Каждый раз, когда соклановец жмет «🤝 помочь», время твоей стройки или исследования сокращается. Система выбирает то, что больше:
• Либо 1 минута;
• Либо 1% от общего времени задачи.
На первых порах это кажется мелочью, но когда здания начнут строиться по несколько суток, один клик друга сэкономит тебе часы, а полный набор помощи — целые сутки! 

🟡 Золотое правило новичка.
Запомни порядок действий, чтобы не терять время впустую:
 1. Ставишь здание на стройку.
 2. Жмешь кнопку «🤝 Помощь».
 3. Ждешь, пока полоска помощи заполнится максимально.
 4. И только в самом конце используешь свои личные ускорители.
Почему это важно? Если ты сначала используешь свои предметы и сократишь стройку с 10 часов до 1 часа, то 1% помощи будет считаться от оставшегося часа. Это копейки! Сначала забирай бесплатный процент от максимума, а потом добивай остальное сам.
💡 Совет: Не забывай и сам заходить в раздел помощи — это помогает твоим союзникам расти быстрее, а альянсу — становиться сильнее.

🏆 ЛАЙФХАК ДЛЯ ПРОДВИНУТЫХ: Как ускорить стройку и исследования.
​Если планируешь запустить «длинную» стройку (от 3-х дней и выше), не спеши нажимать кнопку! Сначала выжми максимум из бонусов, заняв правильную должность.

author: livingwhole.e
text:
Here are the steps to set up a title appointment.

thread: 🧠 Early Game Progression Guide (What Actually Matters)
author: zoidseo
text:
If you’re new or still figuring things out, this is the stuff that helped me progress way faster without wasting resources.

🏗️ 1. **Don’t Upgrade Everything**

Biggest mistake early on is trying to level up every building at once.
Focus on:
HQ (always priority)
Tech building
Training buildings (for troop growth)
Infirmary (you’ll need it more than you think)
Everything else can wait. If it doesn’t directly make you stronger or faster, it’s not urgent.

⚙️ 2. **Tech > Everything**

Your research is what really boosts your power long-term.
Early focus:
Troop attack/defense
Training speed
Resource gathering
Don’t waste time on random techs that don’t help your army right away.

🧬 3. **Hero Development (Keep It Simple)**

Don’t try to upgrade every hero.
Pick 2–3 main heroes and stick with them
Focus on leveling + skills for those only
Save your resources instead of spreading them thin
A few strong heroes > a bunch of weak ones.

🐦 4. **Raven & Gear (Underrated Boost)**

A lot of people ignore this early, but it actually adds up fast.
Upgrade your raven whenever you can
Equip gear that matches your main playstyle (don’t just throw random stuff on)
Even small boosts here help a lot in fights

🤝 5. **Join an Active Alliance ASAP**

This is huge.
Faster build + research helps
More rewards from events
Protection from getting farmed
If your alliance is dead, leave. It’s not worth staying.

⚔️ 6. **Events = Free Progress**
Always check events before using speedups or resources.
A lot of the time you can:
Get rewards for upgrading anyway
Double dip your progress
Don’t rush things blindly—time it with events.

🧠 Final Tip

This game is more about efficiency than grinding. If you:
focus upgrades
don’t waste resources
and stay active in events
You’ll progress way faster than most players.

Thanks for reading. Good Luck & Have Fun!

thread: 日本語イベントガイド（試）
author: hanom_b13154
text:
＜TIPS＞
・ファルコンタワーで現れる宝箱マーク
　ワールドマップの「船」または「水晶」。
　一人でクリアしようとするとえらく時間がかかる任務。
　ギルドでシェアして手伝ってもらうと速度が上がる。手伝うと、完了時にささやかな報酬がもらえる。多分手伝ってもらっても自発者の報酬は変わらない。
　クリア後にその部分をタップするとギルドメンバー誰でも1回報酬がもらえる。先着10名。

・大量の兵士を回復させたい。
　ギルドに入っている人限定の裏技。
　まとめて大量に回復するより、少人数の回復を繰り返す方が効率的。
（60分-5分＝55分
　5分-5分+5分-5分+5分-5分+5分-5分+5分-5分+5分-5分+5分-5分+5分-5分+5分-5分+5分-5分+5分-5分+5分-5分＝0分　＋手間）
　適切な時間はヘルプを押してくれるアクティブの人数による。

・無課金でもVIP
　色々なところをタップすると報酬がもらえるこのゲーム。VIPアイコンも例外ではない。
　VIPランクを確認する画面で右上の宝箱をタップするとVIPポイントが少量ずつもらえる。
　VIPポイントが増えてVIPランクが上がると、その瞬間から1時間だけVIPが有効状態になる。
　建築をするときなどに受け取る時間を調節するとちょっと効率が上がるかもしれない。

・ファルコンタワーを貯める
　ファルコンタワー任務はファルコンタワーレベルによって、更新回数（多分更新時に配布イベント数）と、イベント保存数（表示されずに保存されているイベント）と、最大イベント数（多分画面に表示されるイベントの数）が変わる。
　ファルコンタワー任務は、基本的に8時間の期限が決められており、これを過ぎると【多分】消滅する。
　しかし、イベントをクリアして右上に●が表示されている状態だと表示期限を過ぎても消えずに残っていてくれる。
　これを利用して、イベントを保存することができる（らしい）。
　ちなみに、他のドクターをヘルプするイベントに限っては何らかの理由で状態がリセットされることがあるので、クリア状態になっているか時々確認した方が良い。

・サバイバルバトルとギルドバトルのポイント計算方法について
　タップして、その結果が即座に現れる操作に関してはその時点でポイント追加。
　タップして、結果が出るまでに時間差がある事柄に関しては一部変則的。
：わかりやすいもの：
英雄募集・生存者募集・抗毒剤使用・各種ブースト使用・果実使用・スタミナ消費・ファルコンタワー・エッセンス消費・レイヴン宝箱を開く・英雄の欠片を消費・スキルバッジを消費
：作業開始時点でポイント入手：
兵士訓練・URレアリティの秘密作戦と馬車・研究の巻物を消費
：作業完了時にポイント入手：
建物戦力・技術戦力・各種採取

ちなみに、研究は完了報告をしないと次の研究ができないが、建築は完了した状態を放置できる。
バトルの対象になっていない日に完成した建物をそのままにして次の建築を進めておくことで、すぐに建築戦力のポイントを受け取ることができる。
（ただしもちろんその間は建物のレベルを上げた恩恵は受けることができない）

One of the MOST misunderstood things in this game:

💥 Skill Damage DOES NOT mean fixed damage.

When Marlena says:
“530.4% ATK Energy DMG”

…it means the skill scales from
 HER ATTACK STAT 👀

So:
✅ more ATK = bigger hits
✅ better gear = stronger skills
✅ stars = massive scaling jumps
✅ passives multiply damage further

This is why:
⚠️ the SAME hero can feel weak early…
…but terrifying later.

A low-investment Marlena and a fully built Marlena are basically two different heroes 😭🔥

💡 Biggest lesson:

Some heroes are designed to scale over time — not dominate instantly.

thread: Setting Up Triangle Arena (Defense and Attack)
author: skyyzies
text:
**DEFENSE**
1. Keep all defense lineups as even as possible. The winner only needs to win two, and the attacker has the advantage of picking which teams to fight. If you put your best heroes in one lineup, the attacker can avoid it by attacking the other two.
2. Power isn't everything. Multiple stategies can help and finding what is best may take some trial and error.
3. Monitor wins and losses. See who is winning or losing against you to see if changes to your setup are needed.
4. All teams will look a little different! Trial and error is a great way to start.
5. I recommend starting with one of your three best tanks on each team. From there, fill in the back row with stronger heroes; for a weaker team add stronger heroes and for a stronger team, add weaker heroes. This is also when I would place the second tank in each front two.
6. If any teams become way weaker or stronger, move heroes around.
7. A balanced defense may not prevent people stronger than you from knocking you down in the ranking, but it will help and keep people weaker than you from being able to knock you down the rankings.
**ATTACK**
1. Your 10 best heroes should be interchangable, as needed, on your top two teams. The top 10 hero placements should be based on the defense of the oppoent.
2. I pair my ranger team against the opponents ranger team or warrior team. I also pair my warrior team against a warrior team or warlock team.Then I move people as needed; keeping things close in terms of power and hero strength/weakness.
3. Avoid the opponents strongest set up, especially when they put their strongest heroes in one. 
4. Arena favors the attacker; giving them the ability to see what they are up against. Use this advantage strategically!
5. Faction bonuses are important to look at when attacking, because you can see what you are up against and better counter their defense.
6. It takes time and effort to match your attack for each defense, but getting higher in the ranking is worth it!

**This is why an even defense is best**

In the first example the top two opponent (red) set ups are semi even, but my best set up is better than either of their opponents split strength.

In the second example, all the opponents (red) heroes are in a single set up. That means I can pair my worst troops with their best one and focus on the other two. The two that have little strength. They also have me a super easy win with their worst heroes all together.

When I am up against an opponent with even defense, I am more likely to lose if they are stronger than me. If I am against an opponent with an uneven defense I will usually win, even if they are stronger than me.

📝 BASIC PVP TIPS

🎯 SELECTIVE ENGAGEMENT
- Always attack those you can beat; always defend those you can successfully defend.
- Avoid stronger players than you, do not attack strong players under any circumstance.
- Do not Reinforce/Defend from attacks you can't win, watch out the power of the incoming attacker and their incoming squad. No Suicide Defense.

🛡️ SMART DEFENSE
- Hospital & Defeat Penalties: If the enemy defeats squads while in defense formation (sitting in your base), losses skyrocket. Manually clear your walls. (Remove squad 2 & 3 in the check boxes of your wall building).
- Every time your base is burned, you lose a heavy chunk of 400 units automatically.



📝 ADVANCED PVP TIPS

🛟 DEFENSIVE MANEUVERS (When a Strong Player Targets You)
- If a high-power enemy locks onto your base and starts marching, don't wait passively to be destroyed. Use one of these two tactical reactions immediately:
- - Option A: The Teleport (Evasion) Use any method of teleportation. Move away immediately to make them march toward empty space and waste their time.
- - Option B: The Even Shot. Take your main squad and launch a focused attack on their base immediately instead of waiting for defeat. The Logic: Their main squad is out too, so this is an even shot. You can potentially wreck their unprotected assets before their march hits your empty base.

⚔️ THE OPPORTUNITY DEFENSE & REINFORCEMENT (Against weak players)
- The Key Moment: If weaker enemies are attacking you or your allies, do not ignore it. Always defend or reinforce against those attacks you can successfully overcome. Send your strongest troops to back up your teammates or secure your own wall at the last second. Doing this does not just save your own troops and your teammates' squads from taking heavy damage—it actively traps the attacker and awards you a massive stack of free kills.

Upgrading buildings can take ages to complete. Today, I'm going to take you through a guide to show you exactly how you can cut down this time to make progression much faster using the tips currently available in the game.

Many of you might not be paying close attention to this, but working on these specific areas will help you in the long term by ensuring a much faster progression with your upgrades. So, let's just dive right in! 🚀

🔬 1. Research (Full Development Tree)
To start off with first things first, upgrading buildings can take a massive amount of time. For example, to upgrade my Research Lab to level 27, the regular time required is 37 days and 22 hours. However, right now, it only takes me 20 days and 11 hours. The reason for this massive reduction is my research.

If we look at the Full Development tree in the Research lab, there are two specific researches that help cut down your upgrade times:

🔹 The First Research: Maxing this out will grant you a 5% construction speed bonus.

🔹 The Second Research: Located further down the exact same tree, upgrading this one to level 5 will cut your upgrade time by an additional 10%.

🤝 2. Alliance Research
The next speed boost comes from your alliance, and this one heavily depends on which alliance you are currently in. Because of this, it is highly important to be part of an extremely active alliance that will benefit you in the long run.

📈 In the Alliance Research menu under the Development tab, there is one specific technology that helps with upgrades called Fast Building.

🌟 Maxing out this research will give you a maximum of a 20% speed-up for your upgrades. This is why it is incredibly important to make sure you are in an active alliance!

author: chuppergaming
text:
!

👑 3. VIP Status
Next up is your VIP level. Activating your VIP status provides a massive boost to your building construction speed. Right now, I am at VIP 11, and it is giving me a 45% bonus, which is a massive amount. 🔥

🏛️ 4. Royal City & Official Appointments
This next tip is something that many of you might be forgetting about, but it is a crucial step to follow:

Tap on your profile information in the top left corner and head over to your State/Royal City menu. (Alternatively, you can just go to the World Map and tap directly on the Royal City).

Go to the "Manage" section and open the Official Appointments menu.

Here, you will see a specific title designated just for upgrading: the Minister of Construction.

🏆 Securing this title grants you an extra 50% building construction speed, which is absolutely incredible!

🧮 How the Buff Math Actually Works
Now, this is something that many players misunderstand. You might be thinking: "I'm getting 50% from the title, 45% from my VIP level, plus bonuses from my own research and my alliance research. Why doesn't the building finish instantly if my total percentage adds up to well over 100%?"

That is a completely fair question! However, the math actually applies to the remaining time, rather than stacking directly off the base time. > 📉 How it calculates: Let's say your lab originally takes 37 days to upgrade. The game will first cut 10% off that total. Then, it takes the remaining time left over and cuts 5% off of that new number, and so on.

Because the modifiers apply consecutively, you won't get instant completions, but you will still end up with a massive total time reduction by stacking them all together. Combining your individual research, alliance tech, active VIP status, and the Minister of Construction title will heavily cut down those timers.

author: hottchoklit
text:
Good question. ❤️

The roles aren't official game categories—just a framework to help newer players understand what different heroes contribute to a team.

For example, I consider Marlena a "Scaling DPS" because her impact increases significantly with investment and longer battles compared to many heroes who peak earlier.

Greenwald is listed under Utility/Control because he brings effects beyond pure damage, even if "debuff" may not be the most accurate word choice.

That said, hero roles in Last Asylum overlap a lot, and many heroes can fit multiple categories depending on how you use them. 😊

thread: 🎖️ The Ultimate Troop Training Strategy Guide
author: chuppergaming
text:
🏗️ Step 2: Optimize Your Training Grounds
You can have a total of 4 Training Grounds (3 unlocked via Sanctuary level, 1 from the Development research tree). Instead of wasting resources leveling all of them equally, use this staggered setup:

Training Ground #1 (Max Level): Upgrade this to your maximum Sanctuary level (e.g., Level 27) to unlock your highest available troop tier (e.g., Tier 9).

Training Grounds #2, #3, and #4 (Level 10): Keep the remaining three at Level 10. This is just high enough to train Tier 4 (T4) troops, saving you massive amounts of building resources.

Training Ground yang menganggur berarti produksi pasukan berhenti. Setiap jam yang terlewat merupakan potensi perkembangan akun yang hilang.

thread: How to Maximize Your Squad Power Through Research
author: al_mukni
text:
2. SQUAD 1/2/3/4 RESEARCH

This section contains many useful upgrades, but some research options require a significant amount of time while providing only limited benefits to your main squad.
Prioritize research that directly improves the combat effectiveness of Squad 1.
In addition, Death Reduction is one of the most valuable research options, especially for PvP. It helps reduce troop losses during battles, allowing you to preserve more troops after combat.

thread: How to Maximize Your Squad Power Through Research
author: al_mukni
text:
3. ELITE TROOPS RESEARCH

Elite Troops is one of the most important research branches because it serves as a gateway to powerful late-game upgrades.

When your Elite Troops Research reaches 40% completion and your Laboratory reaches Level 21, you will unlock access to Offensive Tactics and Defensive Tactics research. Both of these research branches provide substantial combat bonuses and significantly increase the effectiveness of your main squad.

In addition to standard combat attributes, Elite Troops Research also contains several special upgrades, including Troop Morale and Damage Reduction. These upgrades can significantly improve your squad's performance during battles by increasing combat efficiency and reducing incoming damage.

Unlike most research branches, Elite Troops Research requires Research Scrolls instead of regular resources. Because of this, players should plan their Research Scroll usage carefully and prioritize upgrades that provide the greatest combat benefits.

Another advantage of saving Research Scrolls is their value during Alliance Duel Day 3 (Research Day). Completing Elite Troops Research grants a large amount of points, making it one of the most effective ways to contribute to your alliance's score while simultaneously strengthening your account.

You should also consider unlocking T10 Troops as a long-term objective, as they offer a major improvement in combat performance compared to lower troop tiers.

thread: How to Maximize Your Squad Power Through Research
author: al_mukni
text:
4. HERO RESEARCH

Unlike most other research branches, almost every upgrade within Hero Research provides valuable benefits for account progression.
There are three available paths:
•Warrior
•Ranger
•Warlock

For Early Game and Mid Game players, it is highly recommended to prioritize the Warrior path first. Warrior research generally requires less time to complete and is currently the most effective and widely used troop type in the game's meta.

Ranger and Warlock research should primarily be used to unlock the requirements needed for advanced Warrior research. Once your Warrior research is well-developed, you can begin investing more heavily in Ranger or Warlock based on your preferred squad composition.

thread: How to Maximize Your Squad Power Through Research
author: al_mukni
text:
CONCLUSION

If your goal is to maximize the power of Squad 1, avoid spreading your research resources across too many branches at the same time. Instead, focus on research that improves Attack, Defense, HP, Damage, and other key combat-related attributes.

Remember, a higher account power does not always mean a stronger Squad 1. Many players gain large amounts of power through Economy, Development, or other non-combat research branches. However, in PvP, a player with focused combat research can often outperform opponents with significantly higher account power.

In the end, smart research priorities will contribute far more to your squad's strength than simply chasing higher power numbers. 💪

Every research tree has a purpose:

thread: Maximizing Damage on the Demon King Blight
author: callikoneko
text:
When attacking the Demon King, there are a few tips and tricks to look out for. Now much of this is subjective and depends on how strong your heroes are in stars and skills, as well as the gear and placement of your heroes.

However, you need to understand that there is no cookie cutter design for your march to attack the Demon King, because it depends a lot on what you have leveled and who works well together. And some things we still are not sure why they work, so it may take a little bit of testing to find what will work best for you.

***__Offense over Defense__***

The Demon King does not fight back. So there is no need to keep tanks that help to defend your damage dealers. Instead, you want to pump as much damage as is possible to push into the Demon King.

To do this it is recommended to take either 4 damage dealers and 1 support, or 3 damage dealers and 2 supports that will boost multiple damage dealers.

Because your supports do less damage themselves but boost other damage dealers, you want to make sure you are using supports that compliment each other, and that doesn't necessarily mean that you want the same faction. For that, you want to look into the skills of all of your heroes to see what type of damage they do and who would be buffed how. (More on this later.)

Also, because damage is important, it is also helpful to include a purple damage dealing hero into your line up, simply because the purple SSR heroes tend to have an increased damage to monsters (which the Demon King is). Recommended for this are:
- Claire has a passive skill which makes every attack do more damage to monsters, given to the 3 Warriors with the highest attack.
- Ash has a passive skill which makes every attack do more damage to monsters, given to the 2 Rangers with the highest attack.
- Stellar has two skills that will periodically pop to aid the fight. The first increases the damage to monsters by all warlocks, and the second increases overall damage taken by monsters for a small amount of time.

__***Fashionable Gear for Damage***__

When you are equipping your lineup, you want to try to adjust the gear so that it can help with the damage you are dealing. 

- *Boots and Chest*: These are not really important at all against the Demon King. These increase your Defense, Physical and Energy Damage Resistance, and Health Points, which are not necessary when you are fighting something that doesn't hit back. So whatever level you have is fine.

- *Swords*: You want the highest level gold UR swords you can get. This is because it improves the the base of your hero's attack and to their critical attack chance, which can boost damage exponentially. A +0 UR sword will do more than a +30 SSR sword for the Demon Kings, despite the monster damage boost.

- *Gloves*: This is the one that's a little weird. You do not really want to use the gold UR gloves. While yes, they do increase Hero's Attack, they also increase Damage Resistance, which is a defensive bonus. The SSR gloves, especially if you have them at level 30, will do extra damage to monsters, and at level 30, it's a 12.25% extra damage which can do more damage than UR gloves because there's no dual stack of Attack and Critical like on the sword. The reason for this is because, unlike the UR Gloves, the modifiers on the SSR Gloves affect **damage** and not **attack**. ATK scales the base of a skill, damage modifiers affect the output after all other calculations are done.

Now obviously, if you don't HAVE a UR sword or a SSR glove left, anything is better than nothing. But if you have a little extra herbs, crafting supplies and gear stones, consider crafting what you need and leveling it in between your main things just for the damage boost on your Demon King attacks.

thread: Maximizing Damage on the Demon King Blight
author: callikoneko
text:
__***Skills are important!***__

It cannot be stressed enough just how important your Hero's skills are to them. The maximum damage you can do is going to depend entirely on how many skill ranks you have in each skill, which requires Shards to star your heroes to unlock them.

You also want to take the time to read your skills so you can figure out who to pair with who and make the best Demon King killing squad possible.

For example, if you used a squad filled with Marlena, Claire, Cynthia, Harper and Bell, there's a few stacking bonuses that play here, depending on how strong each hero is. Let's break this down a little bit.

Harper will increase the Attack of ALL the heroes he's in a party with by using his ultimate skill, and he will increase the attack of all warrior heroes -- so himself, Claire and Marlena would get a double boost from him.

Similarly, Bell will boost the two allies with the strongest attacks, and again, depending on your hero strength on who she boosts, but let's assume Marlena and Cynthia are the same levels, so she boosts Marlena and Cynthia. She also increases the attack of all ranger heroes, boosting herself and Cynthia.

And Claire will boost the 3 warriors with the highest attack to do more damage to monsters, so that's going to be herself, Marlena, and Harper.

In this scenario, Marlena is boosted four times, and Cynthia two. Marlena has her own energy damage increase to boost herself, so she's going to be pumping out damage. And Cynthia is all about the critical strikes, and boosts those on herself, so she might not do as consistent damage as Marlena, but when she lands a critical, she will likely do just as much if not more.

__Using Complimentary Heroes__

Sometimes, while it might seem good to just have the highest attack heroes together, that doesn't necessarily mean that two heroes will work well together. Again, this comes down to reading your skills and making the best decision that you can make for yourself. 

But as an example, let's look at Jester and Zoya and Annie.

Jester's skills specifically deal physical damage, but Zoya has a skill that deals Energy damage to enemies, and while enemies are within her whirlwind, they will take extra energy damage. So, Jester really won't help much with that. 

Similarly, Annie does damage to the two enemies with the highest attack, so when she's against 1 enemy, or against enemies that have multiples of the same thing all at the same level, she doesn't focus her fire on two, it's more random.

Read through and find out who pairs well together to build the best squad that you can with complimentary skills!

__Skill Cooldowns__

Now, that said, knowing what your skills do and who boosts who doesn't mean that you are going to always get those boosting buffs. In this case, you want to look at each skill's cooldown. The skills are used in order of the cooldown. What this means is that when a battle starts, second 1, the cooldowns will start counting down. Once the countdown is over, the skill will be used, then the cooldown starts again. So if Harper's boost is not quicker than Marlena's, Marlena will not benefit from his double boost. 

All gold UR heroes have a special skill that they get automatically when they reach level 30 and have 8 stars. This skill is called Tenacity, and it increases their Attack, Health Points, Defense and also reduces the cooldown speed. So it can be beneficial to make sure the heroes you use are at least 8 stars so that you can try to better line up your skills so they go off at the correct times to get the maximum boost to each.

As you upgrade your skills, the percentages of how much attack (or defense, in the case of tanks) your heroes do will also increase. So much so, that sometimes you want to focus entirely on your heavy hitters instead of the faction bonus when attacking.

thread: Maximizing Damage on the Demon King Blight
author: callikoneko
text:
__***Faction Bonuses***__

Now there are three different types of Demon Kings: Warrior, Ranger, and Warlock, just like there are the different types of Heroes. These are called factions, and it works sort of like the game Rock, Paper, Scissors.

Warrior beats Warlock, Warlock beats Ranger, Ranger beats Warrior. So you are going to get a 50% increase on damage if you use the opposing faction. 

However, that does not mean that you HAVE to use only opposing faction to get the most damage. It is helpful, and having some of the opposing faction can help, but only if it makes sense to use them.

If you have focused hard into only rangers, for example, you can still use your rangers to attack the Warlock Demon King. In my case, I have poured a lot into rangers, and have neglected my warriors. This means that I do more damage on the Warlock Demon King with my rangers than my warriors simply because I have invested so much into the ranger skills that the warriors cannot compete. 

As an example of this: My Cynthia has level 24/25 skills and Red Lady has 11/12, but Marlena's skills are only level 15, Zoya's are 8, so my Rangers have such a stronger attack that they do more damage than my Warriors do, even when factoring their weakness to the Warlock faction vs the increase a Warrior gets. If I want to change this, I have to work on giving them more stars and upgrading their skills, because I have tested it and it is significantly lower damage when the faction bonus would suggest Warriors should do more.

Because of this, the faction bonus is only something you should worry about if you have different faction heroes at same or similar levels, but if there is too big of a power difference, this should not be a factor for you. 

__***Party Placement***__

With the Demon King, because you have no tanks, you can't put tanks in front. So... how do you decide who to put where?

It's hard to say, honestly, and it seems to be different for everyone. Just putting your heroes in a different position can sometimes wildly increase how much damage you do for seemingly no real reason. 

You are given 10 attacks on the Demon King each day (except Sunday). Use those attacks to experiment a little. See what works and what doesn't work, and keep track of what you try so when you find an order that just pumps out the damage, you stick with it.

__***Sanctuary Skins and Effects***__

Skins and Effects can also affect your damage that you do in PVP and against monsters. In this case, the best thing you can use is the Raven Black Fortress skin. Simply by owning it, you have an extra 1% damage to monsters, and by having it equipped you do an extra 5% damage to monsters, for a stacked total of 6%.

The best thing is to just get as much damage as you can, to help win KVK each day!

author: hottchoklit
text:
Growing fast isn't about researching everything... 
it's about researching the RIGHT things.

One of the biggest mistakes I see new players make is spreading their research across every tree equally. It feels productive—but it actually slows your account down.

Here's the priority I recommend for most early-game players:

🏗️ Development → Build and research faster.

💰 Economy → Keep your resources flowing so progress never stalls.

🦸 Hero → Strengthen the commanders leading every battle.

🛡️ Soldier → Improve your troop performance for PvE and PvP.

⚔️ Everything else → Unlock and invest as your account grows and your priorities change.

🍫 Hott Choklit Tip:

Don't chase Power. Build Momentum.

Mid "Defense" (DMG reduction) >

> Left "Initiative" (Defense% buff)

Promoting them evenly one at the time

Since your heroes never receive damage, survivability has no impact on your score. Build your team to maximize damage output.

Damage Heroes

Support Heroes

author: hunalulu0503
text:
🧟 UNDEAD SIEGE – EVENT GUIDE

Last Asylum: Plague

Undead Siege is a new alliance event where teamwork is the key to success. Your alliance must first uncover the hidden Death Prison by collecting 300,000 Clue Points. Clues are earned by defeating Rebels, Blight Legion, Wandering Blights, and by completing activities like gathering resources, helping allies, killing normal Blights, and Alliance Excavation. Once the target is reached, R4 and R5 members can locate the prison and start the event.

Alliance leaders then choose the difficulty. Level 1 starts at 2.4M Enemy Might and requires Territory Level 13, while Level 10 reaches 24.5M Enemy Might and requires Territory Level 27. Higher difficulties also unlock powerful Enemy Mutations, so preview them before confirming your choice.

During the siege, waves of infected enemies attack alliance territories. Shields do not work, so your only defense is placing troops on your city wall before the battle begins. Once your city falls, it won't be attacked again, but your personal rewards stop increasing.

Personal rewards increase by surviving more waves, with major milestones at Waves 1, 4, 8, 10, 13, 16, and 20, rewarding Alliance Tokens, upgrade items, and reward chests.

Alliance rewards depend on your alliance's total waves cleared. Milestones at 50, 100, 150, 200, 250, and 300 waves award Hero XP, Alliance Materials, and Medals. Only members who have been in the alliance for more than 48 hours can claim alliance rewards.

⭐ KrrissGaming Tips

Farm Clue Points early, make sure every member contributes, never rely on shields, deploy troops before the siege starts, choose a difficulty your alliance can handle, check Enemy Mutations first, and stay online to coordinate. Strong teamwork and preparation are the keys to surviving more waves and earning the best rewards.

author: savvy6
text:
Eight Recommendations for Alliance Duel Events:
**1. Save resources throughout the week**

-- It's tempting to use resources, complete research/buildings, upgrade heroes, etc.. throughout the week to feel that constant improvement.

**2. Use each resource during its correct phase.**

-- Resist that temptation to complete an upgrade the instant it's finished, wait to align those upgrades with the proper days for the duels, that way you contribute to the event and get those phase rewards.

**3. Begin with free and passive scoring methods.**
**4. Maximize all personal phase rewards.**

-- Individually, this should be your FIRST goal in alliance duels: get those phase rewards

**5. Stop when the lead is secure.**

--- It may be counterintuitive, but just because it's hero upgrade day doesn't mean you need to burn all your shards if you have all your phase awards and your alliance has a clear lead. Save them for the following week.

**6. Continue only when the alliance needs the points.**

**7. Use upgrades that improve the account rather than upgrades made solely for points.**

-- Don't spend shards, antitoxin, or gearstones on heroes you don't plan on using just for points; save those for Squad 1 and Squad 2.

**8. Recommend shielding before Raid day starts. There will be players who hop instantly to try and catch people offline.**

thread: Top 7 Mistakes In Undead Siege Event
author: hunalulu0503
text:
Top 7 Undead Siege Mistakes Every Player Should Avoid
Last Asylum: Plague – Image Guide by KrrissGaming
Undead Siege is one of the most teamwork-focused events in Last Asylum: Plague. Success isn't just about having high power—it depends on preparation, coordination, and avoiding common mistakes. Here are the Top 7 mistakes that can stop your alliance from reaching higher waves and earning better rewards.
1. Forgetting to Station Heroes
The biggest mistake players make is forgetting to station heroes on their city wall. Even if you have strong troops, your defense becomes much weaker without heroes. Before the event begins, double-check that your strongest heroes and best squad are assigned to your wall. This simple step can make a huge difference in surviving all 20 waves.
2. Ignoring Wall Defense
Many players assume their city will defend itself automatically. It won't. During Undead Siege, your wall is your primary defense. Place your strongest squad on the wall and make sure it's fully prepared before the first wave starts. A properly defended wall greatly improves your chances of surviving every attack.
3. Starting the Event Without Preparation
Undead Siege cannot begin until your alliance fills the Clue progress bar to 100%. Clues are collected before the event by completing Falcon Quests and other activities. Make sure your alliance reaches the required progress before scheduling the event so everyone can participate.

https://youtu.be/8r37RULe41s?si=D0ExcBlKRy2sb88K
4. Underestimating Enemy Mutations
As higher difficulty levels unlock, powerful mutations appear with unique abilities. Many players focus only on zombie waves and ignore these stronger enemies. Learn what each mutation does, watch their attack patterns, and prepare your defense accordingly. Understanding mutations early will help your alliance perform better on future difficulty levels.

thread: Top 7 Mistakes In Undead Siege Event
author: hunalulu0503
text:
5. Not Reinforcing Alliance Members
Undead Siege is an alliance event, not a solo challenge. If weaker members are struggling, send reinforcements to help defend their cities. Stronger defenses allow teammates to survive more waves, increasing the alliance's total wave count. Higher alliance waves unlock better rewards for everyone, making reinforcement one of the smartest strategies.
6. Not Having Enough Troops
Unlike some events, troop losses aren't the biggest issue here. The real problem is starting with too few available troops. If your squads aren't full, your city's defense becomes much weaker. Before launching the event, make sure you have enough healthy troops to fill your strongest marches and maximize your defensive power.
7. Logging Off Without Setting Your Defense
You can still earn rewards while offline, but only if your city is prepared beforehand. Before leaving the game, station your strongest heroes and best troop formation on your wall. A properly configured defense continues fighting automatically, allowing you to survive more waves and contribute to your alliance even when you're not actively playing.
Final Tip
Undead Siege rewards teamwork more than individual strength. Prepare your wall, station heroes, reinforce teammates, keep your squads full, and coordinate with your alliance. Avoiding these seven mistakes will help your alliance reach higher waves, unlock better milestone rewards, and make every Undead Siege event far more successful.

text:
Quick breakdown of Guild Wagon mechanics, wagon master duties, guard selection, rewards & refresh flow <:icon_a05_biaoqing8:1489899233741115412> 

1. Reset
Each alliance gets 1 free Guild Wagon/day. Payment screen = today's free session already used. Resets daily after 11 AM; if it doesn't show up, open/close another event tab.
※ Reset times mentioned in this guide (e.g. 11 AM) are based on Korea Standard Time (KST, UTC+9)

2. Wagon Master & Guards
Online R4/R5 can appoint an online member as Wagon Master. Master collects tickets from guild members (some auto-convert to wagon items) used to refresh items.
Guards & VIPs both claim 2 chests. VIPs just ride along—if your CP is low, pick strong Guards instead to protect the wagon.
Guards must be online to assign; check invite expiration if candidates are offline. Coordinate with your team before starting, or you risk getting plundered undefended (some guilds delay appointing a Master to run it at night for this reason).

3. Rewards & Refresh
Refresh with tickets—5 refreshes = "Golden Wagon," one more press changes contents again. Often good setups without spending too many tickets.
2 chests are for Guards, not the Master—common mistake to grab them yourself.
Passengers: 5 random draws/wagon, 1 vehicle chest each. Wagon Master gets all items from all 4 wagons.

4. Extra Tips
Tapping the stable at destination opens a payment screen for extra runs (~150,000 KRW/day)—few players buy it.
Guild Gift level up also raises Guild Wagon level.

thread: Marlena vs Zoya Which Carry Heros Is Better?
author: hunalulu0503
text:
⚔️ Marlena vs Zoya – Which UR Hero Should You Build?

Choosing between Marlena and Zoya isn't as simple as comparing stats. Both heroes share identical base Attack, HP, Defense, and Command, so the real difference comes from their skills and how they perform in battle.

🔥 Marlena is a burst damage specialist. Her entire kit revolves around eliminating enemies before they can fight back. Peerless Blade delivers massive instant Energy Damage, while Crimson Bloom boosts her Attack before unleashing her combo. Combined with her Energy Damage passive, Marlena excels in Campaign, Arena, and PvP, where ending fights quickly is the key to victory.

🌿 Zoya, on the other hand, focuses on sustained DPS. Her Forest Hunter Ultimate has higher theoretical damage than Marlena's, making her deadly against single-target bosses. Mountain God's Wrath deals continuous AoE damage, while her Crit Rate passive allows her to perform consistently even without perfect gear. She's an excellent choice for long battles and boss content.

🏆 Quick Comparison

Campaign: Marlena ✅

Arena/PvP: Marlena ✅

Boss Battles: Zoya ✅

Wave Clear: Marlena ✅

Early Game: Zoya ✅

Late Game Scaling: Marlena ✅


🎯 Final Verdict

If you're a F2P player or light spender, Marlena is the better overall investment. Her burst damage, faster progression, and versatility make her valuable in almost every game mode. If your priority is boss fights and sustained damage, Zoya is an excellent alternative thanks to her strong Ultimate and built-in Crit Rate.

Both heroes are powerful, but if you can only fully invest in one UR carry, Marlena offers the best value for most players.

💬 Who are you building first—Marlena or Zoya? Let us know below!

author: hunalulu0503
text:
🏴‍☠️ LAST ASYLUM: PLAGUE — MYTHIC TREASURE COMPLETE GUIDE

The Mythic Treasure event is here, and there are several tabs, currencies, mini-games, and rewards to keep track of. Here’s a simple breakdown of what matters most — especially for F2P players.

🪙 1. PIRATE'S MYTHIC TREASURE

This works like an event battle pass. Complete daily activities such as recruiting heroes, training soldiers, joining rallies, dispatching caravans, and making purchases to earn Pass Points.

The Advanced Rewards track costs 499 and provides additional rewards such as Anchor Coins, Pirate Gold, and exclusive chests. If you're spending, this is one of the better-value options.

🎰 2. PIRATE'S GAME

This is the event's slot-machine system. You use Anchor Coins to draw rewards, with a 5X option available.

⚠️ Be careful! The best rewards rely on RNG, so don't spend all your coins chasing one expensive reward. Take your free daily draws first and remember that Anchor Coins can also be exchanged for guaranteed rewards.

🏴‍☠️ 3. PIRATE MARKET

This is where you can directly exchange Anchor Coins for rewards.

For F2P players, prioritize Speed-Ups, Diamonds, resources, Pearls, and useful event materials before expensive cosmetic items.

The 4,000 Anchor Coin ship skin looks tempting, but don't sacrifice all your guaranteed rewards just to chase it.

🍗 4. GRAND FEAST

Grand Feast is a server-wide event. Submit 10 Sea Fish to gain 1 Banquet EXP and compete on the personal leaderboard.

The top 50 can receive valuable rewards, making this one of the best F2P sections of the event.

🐟 5. DELICIOUS HUNT

This is where you farm Sea Fish through activities including Falcon Tower, Resource Monsters, Elite Blight, Black Ops, and Wandering Blight.

🔥 Daily cap: 300 Sea Fish.

Once you reach the cap, stop farming and move on to other activities.

https://youtu.be/boI5El6zCEs?si=AYgLy_s5araYtEqu

thread: Mythic Treasure Event F2P Guide And Strategy
author: hunalulu0503

💎 6. DEEP SEA'S GIFT

This rewards cumulative Diamond spending during the event. It ranges from 1,000 to 100,000 Diamonds.

F2P players shouldn't chase these rewards. If you're already spending, your purchases will naturally contribute toward the milestones.

🃏 7. BURIED TREASURE

A match-three puzzle mini-game where you match three identical cards. You have 5 free daily challenges.

Use Remove, Recall, and Refresh strategically when the board gets difficult. Rewards include Pearls, Puzzle Pieces, and Speed-Ups.

⭐ F2P DAILY PRIORITY
🐟 Farm 300 Fish
🍗 Submit Fish to Grand Feast
🃏 Complete 5 Buried Treasure attempts
🎰 Use your free Pirate's Game draws
🪙 Spend Anchor Coins on guaranteed-value rewards first

Upgrade buildings required for the next tier of upgrades.
Keep Research running continuously.
Recruit and level up Survivors/Heroes.
Do not leave Construction and Research queues idle.

Days 3–4 — Power Push
Level up Heroes and skills.
Upgrade equipment and troops.
Upgrade buildings that boost Might.
Use resources efficiently.
Participate in Alliance activities to gain assistance and rewards.

Days 5–6 — Major Push
Start using the Speed-ups you have accumulated.
Focus on high-value building upgrades and Research.
Train and promote troops.
Upgrade Heroes and Sanctuary facilities.
Use stockpiled resources to reach Final Dawn milestones.

Day 7 — FINAL PUSH 🔥
Check for unreached milestones.
Use remaining Speed-ups, resources, Hero EXP, and materials.
Complete upgrades that provide the biggest Might boost.
Claim all Final Dawn rewards before the event ends.

⭐ PRIORITIES
Sanctuary → Buildings → Research → Heroes → Troops → Resources → Alliance

⚠️ KEY STRATEGY
Don't chase Might by exhausting all your resources on day one. Stockpile resources and Speed-ups, then make a major push leading up to key milestones or the final day. Ensure Construction, Research, Training, and other progression activities are always running.

Not every building in Last Asylum deserves the same amount of resources, and upgrading the wrong buildings can slow down your overall progression. In this guide, we’re ranking the Top 10 Buildings that can make the biggest difference to your account.

The ranking is based on overall usefulness, progression value, resource efficiency, and long-term importance.

🔟 #10 — Early-Game Utility

Some buildings may not look impressive, but they provide useful bonuses and support your daily progression. Don’t completely ignore these buildings, but prioritize them after your main progression buildings.

9️⃣ #9 — Resource & Production

Resource buildings become increasingly important as upgrade costs grow. Keeping your production healthy helps you maintain a steady supply of materials instead of constantly running out.

8️⃣ #8 — Training & Military Support

Military-related buildings are essential for improving your army and keeping your account competitive. Upgrade them when they unlock stronger troops, higher capacity, or important progression requirements.

7️⃣ #7 — Alliance Stable

The Alliance Stable provides valuable alliance-related benefits and should not be forgotten. If you're active in an alliance, its importance increases even further.

6️⃣ #6 — Temple

The Temple is another building worth investing in as your account develops. Its benefits become more valuable as you progress and should be considered when planning your long-term upgrades.

5️⃣ #5 — Watchtower

The Watchtower is an important defensive and progression building. Keeping it upgraded can improve your overall development and ensure you aren't falling behind your other key structures.

4️⃣ #4 — Gear Workshop

The Gear Workshop is one of the most important buildings for strengthening your account. Gear directly impacts your combat performance, so investing in this building can provide a noticeable power increase.

thread: Ultimate Starter Guide: Era of Revival Season | Last Asylum: Plague
author: chuppergaming
text:
Welcome to the Era of Revival season! Whether this season is about to launch on your server or you are looking to get a head start, knowing where to focus your energy from Day 1 will set you up for massive success.

This step-by-step guide breaks down the essential strategies, skill choices, and progression tips you need to dominate the season.

Step 1: Focus on Resistance in the Lord Statue
Your primary focus at the start of the season must be Resistance.

Why it matters: Resistance is the first major wall that will block your personal account progress. Without enough Resistance, your combat efficiency against seasonal threats drops drastically.

Action Item: Make upgrading Resistance in the Lord Statue your top daily priority right from Day 1.

Step 2: Select the Right Skill Tree for Your Playstyle
The Lord Statue features two distinct skill trees: Handyman and Legion Commander. Choosing the right path depends on your main goals for the season:

🛠️ Option A: Handyman Tree (Recommended for F2P & Mid-Spenders)
Focus: Fast progression and development.

Benefits: Delivers massive reductions on both research and building upgrade times.

Verdict: The most efficient choice for rushing Sanctuary levels and pushing toward Tier 10 troops.

⚔️ Option B: Legion Commander Tree (Recommended for Whales & PvP Focus)
Focus: Direct combat and open-world PvP.

Benefits: Provides powerful battle buffs, troop healing perks, and rally enhancements.

Verdict: Ideal if you are already high-power and leading alliance war efforts.

Step 3: Efficiently Farm Resource Monsters & Elite Blight
Seasonal monsters require specific Resistance levels to defeat easily, but don't let recommended requirements hold you back:

Attempt Monsters Even Under Penalty: Even if the game displays a 30% damage penalty due to low Resistance, attempt the fight anyway—you will often still be able to clear it.

Rally for Elite Blight: High-level Elite Blights are critical for long-term progression. If you lack the required Resistance, ask an alliance member with higher Resistance to join your rally. Their stats will allow your rally to clear the target easily.

Step 4: Maximize Value on Season Purchases (For Spenders)
If you plan to spend a few dollars during the season, timing and offer selection are crucial to getting the best value:

Week 1 Priority — Battle Pass & Weekly Era Pass:

Purchasing these in Week 1 gives you immediate access to Specialty XP and a +250 Resistance boost.

This extra Resistance allows you to defeat higher-level Resource Monsters and Elite Blights much earlier than other players.

Exclusive Weapons & Hero Awaken Shards:

Hold off on buying these packs until the Exclusive Pass Event is active to maximize your bonus rewards.

Final Checklist & Next Steps
Day 1: Start upgrading Resistance in the Lord Statue immediately.

Skill Tree: Lock in Handyman (Progression) or Legion Commander (PvP).

Daily Routine: Push Elite Blight levels with alliance rally help and burn stamina on Resource Monsters.

Week 1 Value: Secure the Battle Pass / Weekly Era Pass early if spending.

⚠️ *What has been discussed is purely theoretical; everyone perceives things differently. Find out what works best for you. *⚠️ 

 Right now, many people almost certainly have one strong squad, one medium squad, and one weak squad.
But how do we divide it all up correctly now, to beat Players at the same Might or Lower.

❗ Avoid that u have 1  weak squad.

**Your teams should be structured this way.**

You have 
2 Strong Tanks / 2 Strong Damage Dealer / 1 Strong Support
2 Medium Tanks / 2 Medium Damage Dealer / 1 Medium Support
2 Weak Tanks / 2 Weak Damage Dealer / 1 Weak Support

Your Teams can look like this.

Strong Tank / Weak Tank
Medium Damage Dealer / Medium Damage Dealer / Medium Support

Strong Tank / Weak Tank
Strong Damage Dealer / Weak Damage Dealer / Weak Support

Medium Tank / Medium Tank
Strong Damage Dealer / Strong Support / Weak Damage Dealer

------------------

The goal should be to build your teams so that they benefit most from the faction bonus, while ensuring they are structured to be equally strong.

You don't have to beat opponents with 70 million power in the arena if you have a total power of, say, 50 million. But you should set yourself the goal of giving players of equal strength a serious challenge.

Of course, if you have all ur factions at 10 stars, that’s a completely different story. However, in this case, you can try to make life harder for your opponent by using targeted counters on defense.

When your set up looks like 5 Warlock 5 Warrior 5 Ranger you can put your strongest Damage Dealer in the countered Squad.

👑 How to get Red Scrolls as a F2P/P2W 👑 

*(p stands for Pickaxe / f for Floors)*

Every player needs them and everyone knows the problem with the red scrolls.
You only get it as an achievement from the Ranger Boss Blight.

❗ **But there is another way.** ❗ 

Specifically, the ❗  **Dwarven Mine Event** ❗ . For completing all 100 stages, you'll get 10 Red Scrolls.

Let's break down the math for both Free-to-Play (F2P) and Pay-to-Win (P2W) players, incorporating the actual in-game pity mechanism (Special Reward guarantee) and statistical probabilities.

------------------
**(F2P)**

- F2P: 12p / day x 7 days = 84p per event (1 week)

------------------
**(P2W)**

- P2W (1 Shop Pack per week): 84 + 42 = 126p per event (1week)

------------------

**The In-Game Pity System (Guaranteed Maximum)**

According to the in-game notice, you are guaranteed a Special Reward (moving up to the next floor) after a specific number of failed digs per floor type:

- Floors ending in 1 & 6: Guaranteed on the 6th dig (after 5 fails)
- Floors ending in 2 & 7: Guaranteed on the 7th dig (after 6 fails)
- Floors ending in 3 & 8: Guaranteed on the 9th dig (after 8 fails)
- Floors ending in 4 & 9: Guaranteed on the 6th dig (after 5 fails)
- Floors ending in 5 & 0: Guaranteed on the 11th dig (after 10 fails)

**Absolute Worst-Case Calculation (0 Luck / Pity Limit):**

Per 10f = (6+7+9+6+11) x = 78

For 100f = 78 x 10 = 780

------------------

**How many events do u need ? (Worst-Case / 100% Guaranteed)**

**(F2P)** 780p / 84p per event ≈ 9,28 Events ≈ 10 Events to be safe

**(P2W)** 780p / 126p per event ≈ 6.19 Events ≈ 7 Events to be safe

text:
Hello from #247's own [HOLY]DrGayLord! Credit to HOLY for teaching me these

__First Building to Pay Attention to__
* The Sanctuary: 
  * Sanctuary level = Player level
  * Reduce construction time
  * Increase hero's max level
  * Unlock more building for construction
  * Qualify for certain events
  * Increase your might
* Antitoxin Workshop: one of the earlier buildings you'll construct:
  * Produce level items
* The Tavern: 
  * Recruit Survivors/Heroes

__Getting Started with Gear__
There are three important buildings that will contribute to your quest for gear:
1. Gear Workshop
  * dismantle gear
  * fuse resources
  * craft gear
2. Weaving Workshop
  * create cloth for fusing/crafting gear
3. Smelting Workshop
  * produce gearstone to level up gear

~DrG's tips on gear~
* don't waste your materials upgrading the green and blue gear. 
* ONLY craft UR/orange. It's the best gear you'll get and a much better investment than crafting something you can get for free
* for fast progression, only deck out squad 1
  * swords and gloves for carries
  * chestplates and boots for tanks

__Building your Squad__
There are both 3 factions and hero types. The factions are like rock-paper-scizzors:
* Warrior Faction: indicated by the red sword under a hero's name; strong against warlocks
* Warlocks indicated by green spellbook; strong against rangers
* Rangers indicated by blue arrowhead; strong against warriors

The three types of heroes indicate their role in your squad:
* Carry (explosion icon): main damage
* Tank (shield): main defense
* Support (potion bottle) assists other roles to heal/take less damage/deal more damage/etc.

~DrG's Suggestions~
* Keep 2 tanks up front to protect the rest of your squad
* 2 carries and 1 support in your back line for big damage
* Read skill descriptions before you upgrade. Avoid skills that mention being good against monsters
*Try to have all/mostly one faction since you get a damage bonus for having same faction heroes!

thread: Annie vs Jester — Which Warlock Carry Should You Build?
author: hunalulu0503
text:
Annie and Jester are both powerful UR Warlock carries in Last Asylum, but they perform very different roles.

🃏 Jester — The Executioner

Jester specializes in finishing weakened enemies. His attacks prioritize enemies with the lowest HP, while his ultimate, Joker Ace, targets two low-HP enemies. This makes him excellent at turning damage into eliminations.

His Crit Rate passive also gives him strong burst potential. Jester is at his best when your team has already damaged the enemy and he can step in to secure the kill.

Best for: Burst damage, execution and finishing weakened targets.

Skill Priority:
Joker Ace → Hearthunt Red Card → Frenzied Emotion → Deal Cards

🍬 Annie — The Burn Specialist

Annie is a more proactive damage dealer. Instead of waiting for enemies to become weak, her ultimate targets enemies with the highest ATK, allowing her to pressure dangerous enemy carries.

Her main strength is Burn synergy. Surprise Gift can apply Burn, while Candy Jar can further punish burning targets. Her passive also boosts Energy damage, supporting her entire kit.

Best for: Sustained damage, Burn, Energy damage and targeting dangerous carries.

Skill Priority:
Candy Jar → Surprise Gift → Charged Gummies → Candy

⚔️ Gear Priority

For both heroes:

Sword → Gauntlets → Armor → Boots

Prioritize offensive gear first because both Annie and Jester are carries.

🏆 Final Verdict

Burst Damage: Jester
Sustained Damage: Annie
Finishing Power: Jester
Crit Potential: Jester
Burn Damage: Annie
Skill Synergy: Annie
Target Priority: Annie

Overall Winner: 🏆 Annie

Annie is the better overall investment for most players because she can immediately pressure dangerous high-ATK enemies and her skills work together through Burn and Energy damage.

Jester is still an excellent choice if you need a powerful finisher.

Jester finds the wounded enemy and finishes them. Annie finds the dangerous enemy and burns them down.
